title: In vitro Assembly of Semi-artificial Molecular Machine and its Use for Detection of DNA Damage
protocol: Place the sections in a slide rack.
Dewax in xylene for 15 minutes.
Transfer to a fresh xylene bath for an additional 5 minutes.
Rehydrate by passing through 96% ethanol -2x5min.
Rehydrate by passing through 80% ethanol - 5min.
Rehydrate by passing through water - 2x5 min.
Digest section with Proteinase K using 100μL of a 50μg/mL solution per section.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature in a humidified chamber.
Rinse in distilled water for 2x10 min.
Apply 100 μL per section of 2% BSA for preblocking.
Incubate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Combine bidistilled water in a small plastic tube for molecular machines assembly.
Add 15% polyethylene glycol-8000 to the mixture.
Add a solution of 66 mM-Tris HCl, pH 7.5, 5 mM MgCl2, 0.1 mM dithioerythritol, and 1 mM ATP (T4 DNA ligase buffer) to the tube.
Add 70 pmoles of Oligonucleotide 1 to the mixture.
Add 215 pmoles (1.76 - 7.1 μg) VACC TOPO to the solution.
Add 10 units T4 DNA ligase (500 U/mL) to the tube.
Mix gently by pipetting for molecular machines assembly.
Increase temperature to 37°C if needed to block the T4 DNA ligase-based component of labeling.
Aspirate the preblocking solution.

Apply 25 μL of the full reaction mix containing 70 pmoles of Oligonucleotide 1, 53 - 215 pmoles (1.76 - 7.1 μg) VACC TOPO and 10 units T4 DNA ligase in a solution of 66 mM-Tris HCl, pH 7.5, 5 mM MgCl2, 0.1 mM dithioerythritol, 1 mM ATP, and 15% polyethylene glycol-8000.
Incubate for 1 hour at room temperature (23°C) in a humidified chamber with a plastic coverslip.
Protect from light during incubation.
Remove coverslips by gently immersing the slides vertically in a Coplin jar containing water at room temperature.
Aspirate excess water.

Apply 25 μL of reaction mix without VACC TOPO and Oligonucleotide 1, but containing Oligonucleotide 3: 66 mM-Tris HCl, pH 7.5, 5 mM MgCl2, 0.1 mM dithioerythritol, 1 mM ATP, and 15% polyethylene glycol-8000, 5 units T4 DNA ligase, 35 mg/mL Oligonucleotide 3.
Incubate for 18 hr at room temperature (23°C) in a humidified chamber with a plastic coverslip.
Remove coverslips by gently immersing the slides vertically in a Coplin jar containing water at room temperature.
Wash sections 3 times, each for 10 min, in distilled water.
Rinse with sodium bicarbonate buffer.
Alkaline solution rinse enhances FITC fluorescence.
Cover section with an antifading solution (Vectashield with DAPI).
Analyze the signal using a fluorescent microscope.
